(2019 - اللغة الإنجليزية - آداب وفلسفة - الدورة العادية - الموضوع.pdf، 4 صفحات: الموضوع الأوّل ص1–2، الثّاني ص3–4)؛ «الدّورة العاديّة» من اسم الملفّ (الورقة تكتب «دورة: 2019» فقط). الإجابة النّموذجيّة وسلّم التّنقيط الرّسميّان: gdrive:1cLYVJyFmuz_QhrHA9iPlp8MdYxFu_T_X (ص1 «Inca Civilization»، ص2 «Education»). نُسخ النص من صورة الورقة الرسمية (لا نسخة Word): الملفّ PDF رقميّ له طبقة نصّ أصليّة، فأُخذت الحروف منها (علامات الاقتباس المنحنية، «…»، «§»، نقاط الجدول) وطوبقت سطرًا سطرًا مع صور الصّفحات (150 نقطة، ومقاطع من الحلّ بـ300 نقطة). خلاف OCR (read_file_content) والصّورة: المدّة «20» في OCR و«30 د» في الصّورة؛ ترقيم الصّفحتين 2 و3 «0 من 4» في OCR؛ خلايا الجداول (جدول الاشتقاق وجدول المطابقة) مختلطة الأسطر في OCR وصُحّحت من الصّورة؛ التّسطير والخطّ الغامق والأسّ «st» لا يظهر في OCR؛ في الحلّ OCR «its t(§1) : mpireehe» و«:ro» وصوابهما في الصّورة «its (§1) : the empire» و«or:»، وأعمدة الجداول وعلامات «مجزأة» منفصلة عن أسطرها. التّسطير لا يُحفظ في النّصّ: الكلمات المسطّرة حُدّدت من الصّورة وتذكر كلّ خطوة الجملة الّتي فيها الكلمة. قرارات التّحويل (R1–R11 في رأس المحوّل): عنصر لكلّ بند يُنقَّط منفردًا؛ الأسئلة الثّنائيّة (صح/خطأ، نعم/لا) اختيار من خيارين؛ صيغ الحلّ المتعدّدة للإجابة نفسها تبقى تفاعليّة ولا تُعرض صيغة مقبولة مشتّتًا؛ التّعبير الكتابيّ مؤجَّل (essay_builder) بمعايير الشّبكة الرّسميّة (الملاءمة 1، الانسجام الدّلاليّ 1، سلامة اللّغة 2، الإتقان 1). الموضوع الثّاني: المسطَّر It (§1 «It can be a “force multiplier”»)، They (§2 «They can connect with students»)، they (§3 «and they can even check»). س2: لم تُعرض «§4» مشتّتًا (المعلّمون يستعملون التّكنولوجيا لتطوير أنفسهم: قابل للدّفاع)، فالخيارات §1 §2 §3. س3أ: الخيار الصّحيح بلفظ الحلّ «performances» (النّصّ «performance»). س3ب: الحلّ يقبل ثلاثة تعليلات؛ عُرض أوّلها صحيحًا ولم يُعرض الآخران. س3ج: الحلّ يقبل عنصرين من ثلاثة؛ عُرض اثنان صحيحان مع مشتّتين من الفقرة 4 (للمعلّمين). المطابقة (0.5×3) خطوة مطابقة واحدة. إعادة التّرتيب: N.B. «0.5 للجملة الافتتاحيّة و0.5 لكلّ زوج منطقيّ» فقُسّمت إلى أربعة عناصر (الافتتاحيّة + الأزواج d–a، a–c، c–b) لأنّ تنقيط ordering بالمواضع يخالف السّلّم. الشّبكة في الحلّ تكتب «Excellence (vocabulary and creating)» (الموضوع الأوّل: creativity) فنُقلت كما هي. المجموع 20 = 7 + 8 + 5 (تفاعليّ 15، مؤجَّل 5).

original_questions.verbatim_text:
Write the letter that corresponds to the right answer.
A- Technology is a means which …..
a- helps learning only b- improves healthcare c- serves teachers and learners
B- Involving parents in their children’s education…..
a- increases their school performance b- improves their behaviour c- hinders their success

documents.caption: The text
documents.text:
Improving education is a huge issue. Test scores, our perceived performance against other countries, and other factors have pushed education to the forefront of national politics, right behind healthcare reform. Technology can be used to improve teaching and learning and help our students be successful. It can be a “force multiplier” for the teacher. Instead of the teacher being the only source of help in a classroom, students can access online tutorials, and more to assist them.
Education doesn’t stop at the end of the school day because students have access to teachers and resources, at any time. Students can also get help and tutoring at any time, whether from the teachers via email or online collaboration. They can connect with students at other schools and do collaborative work with them.
Parental involvement is another factor that can increase students’ achievement. Thanks to technology, parents can go to a class website and see what their child is working on, they can contact teachers via email and web sites, and they can even check their child’s attendance and grades through online systems.
Teachers can use technology to find resources and attend virtual professional development seminars and conferences. They can also create personal learning networks and other resources to find and share ideas and resources, and get support from their colleagues.

documents.caption: Source
documents.text:
Adapted from: “How Technology Can Help Improve Education”
by : Ragan Whiteside. October 21st ,2011.

original_questions.part: Part one: Reading (15 points) – B/ TEXT EXPLORATION (08 points)
original_questions.verbatim_text:
Reorder the following sentences to get a coherent passage.
a- It gives teachers and students extra resources
b- and work together to get additional knowledge.
c- to access to new opportunities for learning approaches
d- Technology is a powerful tool for education.

Choose ONE of the following topics:
Topic One:
Traditional learning doesn’t offer many opportunities for the learners to develop their skills whereas technology can be of great help. Use the following notes to write a composition of about 80 to 120 words to be published in your school magazine about the benefits of using technology in learning.
The following notes may help you:
-Improve engagement and raise motivation
-Encourage individual learning
-Foster collaboration
-Facilitate knowledge retention
Topic Two:
In your city, statistics show that violence against children is on the rise. As a member of an association that defends the rights of children, write a newspaper article of about 80 to 120 words for your fellow citizens in which you suggest some actions to reduce this phenomenon.

steps.prompt: Choose the right answer: “Technology is a means which …..”
steps.explanation: Key: A → c. “Technology can be used to improve teaching and learning” (§1).

steps.prompt: Choose the right answer: “Involving parents in their children’s education…..”
steps.explanation: Key: B → a. “Parental involvement is another factor that can increase students’ achievement” (§3).

steps.prompt: In which paragraph is it mentioned that technology enhances teaching?
steps.explanation: Key: §1 — “Technology can be used to improve teaching and learning…”.

steps.prompt: Why is education a priority?

options: Because of test scores, our perceived performances against other countries and other factors.
Because healthcare reform is no longer a national issue.
Because students cannot work with students at other schools.
Because teachers are the only source of help in a classroom.

steps.explanation: Key: “Because of test scores, our perceived performances against other countries and other factors.” (§1)

steps.prompt: Is the teacher the only source of help? Why or why not?

options: No, he is not. Students can access online tutorials, and more to assist them.
Yes, he is. Students can only get help from the teacher during the school day.
No, he is not. Parents now give all the lessons at home.
Yes, he is. Technology cannot assist students outside the classroom.

steps.explanation: Key: “No / No, he is not / She is not.” + one reason: “Students can access online tutorials, and more to assist them.” Or: “Students can also get help and tutoring at any time, whether from the teachers via email or online collaboration.” Or: “They can connect with students at other schools and do collaborative work with them.”

steps.prompt: How can technology help parents control their kids? Choose the TWO items mentioned in the text.

options: They can create personal learning networks to share ideas with their colleagues.
They can attend virtual professional development seminars and conferences.
They can check their child’s attendance and grades through online systems.
They can contact teachers via email and web sites.

steps.explanation: Key (any two): “Parents can go to a class website and see what their child is working on.” – “They can contact teachers via email and web sites.” – “They can check their child’s attendance and grades through online systems.” (§3). Seminars and learning networks are for teachers (§4).

steps.prompt: What does “It” refer to in “It can be a “force multiplier” for the teacher.” (§1)?
steps.explanation: Key: a) It (§1): technology.

steps.prompt: What does “They” refer to in “They can connect with students at other schools and do collaborative work with them.” (§2)?
steps.explanation: Key: b) They (§2): students.

steps.prompt: What does “they” refer to in “…and they can even check their child’s attendance and grades through online systems.” (§3)?
steps.explanation: Key: c) they (§3): parents.

steps.prompt: The text is ……
steps.explanation: Key: c) argumentative.

steps.prompt: Match the following words with their corresponding definitions:

rights: Formal teaching that consists of lectures or practicals.
The act of working with someone to create or produce something.
Marks given in an exam or for a piece of school work.

steps.explanation: Key: 1 → b, 2 → c, 3 → a. Grades: marks given in an exam or for a piece of school work. Tutorials: formal teaching that consists of lectures or practicals. Collaboration: the act of working with someone to create or produce something.

steps.prompt: Complete the chart (Example: to educate – education – educative): which verb goes with the noun “achievement”?
steps.explanation: Key: verb → to achieve.

steps.prompt: Complete the chart (Example: to educate – education – educative): which adjective goes with the noun “achievement”?
steps.explanation: Key: adjective → achievable / achieved (both accepted).

steps.prompt: Complete the chart (Example: to educate – education – educative): which noun goes with the verb “to access”?
steps.explanation: Key: noun → access / accessibility / accessor (all accepted).

steps.prompt: Complete the chart (Example: to educate – education – educative): which adjective goes with the verb “to access”?
steps.explanation: Key: adjective → accessible.

steps.prompt: Complete the chart (Example: to educate – education – educative): which verb goes with the adjective “successful”?
steps.explanation: Key: verb → to succeed.

steps.prompt: Complete the chart (Example: to educate – education – educative): which noun goes with the adjective “successful”?
steps.explanation: Key: noun → success / successfulness (both accepted).

steps.prompt: Combine with (such …that): “Some parents have busy schedules. They can’t help their child with homework.”

options: Some parents have such busy schedules than they can’t help their child with homework.
Some parents have so busy schedules that they can’t help their child with homework.
Some parents have such a busy schedules that they can’t help their child with homework.
Some parents have such busy schedules that they can’t help their child with homework.

steps.explanation: Key: “Some parents have such busy schedules that they can’t help their child with homework.”

steps.prompt: Combine with (unless): “Students have access to technology. Their test scores improve.”

options: Unless students have access to technology, their test scores won’t improve.
Unless students don’t have access to technology, their test scores won’t improve.
Unless students have access to technology, their test scores will improve.
Unless students had access to technology, their test scores won’t improve.

steps.explanation: Key: “Unless students have access to technology, their test scores won’t / will not improve.”

steps.prompt: Combine with (while): “The teacher provides help in the classroom. Technology assists learning at any time.”

options: The teacher provides help in the classroom while technology assist learning at any time.
The teacher provides help in the classroom while technology assists learning at any time.
The teacher while provides help in the classroom technology assists learning at any time.
While the teacher provides help in the classroom, while technology assists learning at any time.

steps.explanation: Key: “The teacher provides help in the classroom while technology assists learning at any time.” or: “While the teacher provides help in the classroom, technology assists learning at any time.”

steps.prompt: Reorder the sentences: which sentence opens the passage?

options: c- to access to new opportunities for learning approaches
d- Technology is a powerful tool for education.
a- It gives teachers and students extra resources
b- and work together to get additional knowledge.

steps.explanation: Key: the passage opens with “d- Technology is a powerful tool for education.” (0.5 for the opening sentence).

steps.prompt: Reorder the sentences: which sentence comes right after “d- Technology is a powerful tool for education.”?

options: b- and work together to get additional knowledge.
a- It gives teachers and students extra resources
c- to access to new opportunities for learning approaches

steps.explanation: Key: “d- Technology is a powerful tool for education.” is followed by “a- It gives teachers and students extra resources” (0.5 for each logical pair).

steps.prompt: Reorder the sentences: which sentence comes right after “a- It gives teachers and students extra resources”?

options: c- to access to new opportunities for learning approaches
d- Technology is a powerful tool for education.
b- and work together to get additional knowledge.

steps.explanation: Key: “a- It gives teachers and students extra resources” is followed by “c- to access to new opportunities for learning approaches” (0.5 for each logical pair).

steps.prompt: Reorder the sentences: which sentence comes right before “b- and work together to get additional knowledge.”?

options: d- Technology is a powerful tool for education.
c- to access to new opportunities for learning approaches
a- It gives teachers and students extra resources

steps.explanation: Key: “c- to access to new opportunities for learning approaches” is followed by “b- and work together to get additional knowledge.” (0.5 for each logical pair). Full order: d – a – c – b.
